sentence: The reads are on provider.auth (ProviderAuth) and on model (Model), not on any ModelAuth value.
The min and max are Math.min and Math.max calls, not reads of RangeProps.
Only options.args is read from the launch options copy, and timeout is an object literal key next to mocha this.timeout().
The tools and resources occurrences are object literal keys in a fake server reply and a parsed JSON config, not reads of ServerCapabilities.
The reads are params.context on tool parameters and Object.entries on an env record, not on BoundaryState.
The reads are video.size and video.fps on the test video option and request.dispose on an APIRequestContext, not on ScreencastClient.
The reads are on contextOptions and options typed as the public BrowserContextOptions, not the protocol BrowserNewContextParams.
The data.elements and data.appState reads are on a variable explicitly typed ImportedDataState, not ExportedDataState.
The reads are on this._liveTraceFile (a local file and fs pair) and this._options (local TraceOptions), not on StackSession.
The route request field failed.message is typed AssistantMessage and the test reads its errorMessage and stopReason, and narrowed session messages read model and thinkingLevel.
The reads are on a local options parameter of the assistant helper, not on FauxModelDefinition.
Only options.apiKey is read from the stream options, and headers is read from a locally cast JSON response.
The reads are cleanup on a test harness and signal on getAuth options, not on CombinedAbortSignal.
The matches are in documentation comments of the test type declarations, not reads of BrowserTypeLaunchParams.
The reads are auth on getAuth results, baseUrl on a Model, and headers on image options, while the Provider values only have generateImages and classify read.
The reads are on contextOptions and options typed as the public BrowserContextOptions, not the client BrowserNewContextForReuseOptions.
The reads are on pointerDownState.origin, a local x and y record type, not on RectangleBox.
Only setResponses is read from setup.faux, while state is read from durable task objects.
The reads are on the component props typed by a local Props type, not ImportedDataState.
The reads are model on a durable session entry and provider on the faux provider handle, not on ClassifierResult.
The reads are on an IPC message typed any, not on CDPSessionSendParams.
The reads are closed on an AgentEventStream and input on a usage object, not on GrammarToolInputJsonBuffer.
The reads are on a message parameter typed AssistantMessage, not AssistantImages.
The reads are on a dashboard local AnnotateFrame value, not on PageScreencastFrameEvent.
The reads are the process() method and connection property of the BidiBrowser instance, not of BidiBrowserOptions.
The reads are on session stats objects and a Model from getModel, not on FauxModelDefinition.
The crop variable is element.crop on a narrowed ExcalidrawImageElement, typed ImageCrop, and its x, y, width, height, naturalWidth and naturalHeight are read.
The reads are on match.element, a text element, not on RenderPositionOffset.
The reads are on a usage ledger snapshot entry, not on AiGatewayPricing.
The reads are on messages narrowed to role system (SystemMessage, which declares its own toolsAdded and toolsRemoved), not on ToolStateChanges.
